principle: Classify code by scientific responsibility and lifecycle role, not by execution frequency or device. Labels never authorize moving production code; the overlay is evaluated against the current import/call graph and runtime captures before any migration.

world.role: Prescribed physical descriptions and the reference data they are stated in: planet, star, orbit, rotation, composition, species identity, fundamental constants, prescribed fluid layer and terrain specification. Immutable, CPU-only; no grids, device buffers, integrators or evaluated physics.

setup.role: Configuration resolution, presets, terrain preparation, initial conditions and construction of numerical components.

spectral.role: Grids, quadrature, basis and truncation conventions, transforms, spectral and vertical numerical operators, transform-specific kernels, and the prepared numerical-resource bundle (current Planet class) with its discretization description.

dynamics.role: Prognostic state schemas, the equations that turn a state into tendencies, and the tendency-term/damping contract (temporal.hooks) those terms implement.

physics.role: Physical relationships and parameterizations: radiation, convection, surface exchange, thermodynamic and optical data.

integration.role: Time advancement: steppers, stage/history management, numerical filters, hooks and physics coupling schedules.

run.role: Experiment orchestration, output schedules and checkpoint coordination.

analysis.role: Saved-run access, diagnostics, reductions and visualization.

archive.role: Persistence formats, reconstruction, run identity/provenance and checkpoint encoding.

TEMPORARY: PlanetaryBody stores a StellarIllumination; the canonical descriptor keeps star/orbit/rotation and derives illumination in physics (M2).
TEMPORARY: PlanetaryBody.cp/kappa/regime evaluate heat capacity; evaluation moves to physics helpers behind compatibility properties (M2).
UNRESOLVED: the SWE core consumes a prepared Topography (Topography.flat default). Ownership of prepared boundary fields is open (proposal section 5).
TEMPORARY: the bundle's module imports Planet.generate's procedural-terrain dependencies at module scope; disappears when generate moves to a setup factory (M3).
